description: Add the mohist/pr workflow profile that delivers each issue via a GitHub PR, with a new runner action, failure classification, and web/CLI surfaces for PR delivery metadata.

tasks.title: Register mohist/pr workflow profile in server
tasks.description: Add a second built-in workflow profile `mohist/pr` alongside `mohist/default`. Ship a `mohist-pr.workflow.yaml` resource that is byte-identical to `mohist-default.workflow.yaml` except the `integrate:publish` task's `uses` is `mohist/publish-via-pr` instead of `mohist/publish`. Add a `MohistPrIssueWorkflowProfile` subclass of `MohistIssueWorkflowProfileBase` (Id=`mohist/pr`, IsDefault=false, SuitableFor describing PR-based delivery and noting the gh CLI prerequisite). Extend `MohistWorkflow.cs` with a parallel lazy `PrDefinition` loader, and register the new profile in `IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry` so listing, project/issue selection, and `mo workflow list --described` expose it identically to `mohist/default`.
acceptanceCriteria: `IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry.List()` returns both `mohist/default` (IsDefault=true) and `mohist/pr` (IsDefault=false), each with id/displayName/description/suitableFor.
Selecting `mohist/pr` at project or issue scope resolves the new WorkflowDefinition through the profile manager; selecting nothing still resolves to `mohist/default`.
`mohist-pr.workflow.yaml` parses successfully via `WorkflowYamlSerializer.FromYaml` and the resulting Plan/Build/Check stages match `mohist/default` task-for-task.

The `mohist/pr` Integrate stage declares the same ordered task list (spec-sync, archive-change, prepare, publish) as `mohist/default`, with `integrate:publish` using `mohist/publish-via-pr` and every other Integrate task matching `mohist/default`.
A unit test asserts the two built-in definitions are identical modulo the `integrate:publish` action name (guards against YAML drift).
The profile description surfaces the gh CLI prerequisite so operators see it in `mo workflow list --described` and the Settings Workflows tab.
Server tests pass: `npm test` (dotnet build TreatWarningsAsErrors + tests).
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/WorkflowProfiles/MohistPrIssueWorkflowProfile.cs, mohist-pr.workflow.yaml, updated MohistWorkflow.cs and IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry.cs, plus server-side unit tests
tasks.notes: The YAML may reference `mohist/publish-via-pr` before the runner ships that action; profile registration is independently deployable. Mirror the existing `MohistDefaultIssueWorkflowProfile` shape and the csproj embedded-resource / copy-to-output pattern used for `mohist-default.workflow.yaml`.

tasks.title: Implement mohist/publish-via-pr runner action
tasks.description: Add a new `mohist/publish-via-pr` runner action in `packages/runner/src/actions/publish-via-pr.ts` and register it in `createDefaultRegistry()` in `actions/registry.ts`. The action executes four ordered phases: (1) gh CLI precheck (`gh --version` + `gh auth status`) failing fast with `config-error`; (2) `git push --force-with-lease origin <workspace.branch>`; (3) open-or-reuse the PR for `head:base` via `gh pr list` / `gh pr create`; (4) merge-or-confirm via `gh pr view` + `gh pr merge --squash --subject`. It emits structured `ActionResult.output` JSON with `kind: "publish-via-pr"`, `prNumber`, `prUrl`, `mergeCommitSha`, `targetBranch`, `baseSha`, `pushed`, and `failureKind` from the extended union (`base-moved` | `retry-safe` | `config-error` | `protection-conflict` | `pr-state-conflict`). All `gh` calls go through the existing `runCommand` helper; all `git` calls through the existing `git` helper.
acceptanceCriteria: The action is registered under `mohist/publish-via-pr` and resolves through `ActionRegistry.resolve`.

Missing `gh` on PATH and unauthenticated `gh auth status` both fail fast with `failureKind: "config-error"` and an operator-facing message naming the install + `gh auth login` prerequisite; the action performs no remote mutation in this case.
On first run the action force-pushes the branch, creates a new PR with title `Complete issue #N` and body `Mohist issue #N` (no `Closes #N`), and squash-merges it with subject `Complete issue #N`.
On re-attempt after a prior push, the `--force-with-lease` push succeeds rather than failing non-fast-forward.
When an open PR already exists for the same `head:base`, the action reuses it and does NOT create a duplicate.
When the action observes the PR in `state=merged` before invoking merge, it reports success without calling `gh pr merge` and still returns `prNumber`/`prUrl`/`mergeCommitSha`.
Unmergeable PR caused by base movement reports `base-moved`; the action does NOT run an internal rebase loop.
Branch-protection rejections report `protection-conflict`; externally-closed or state-changed PRs report `pr-state-conflict`; transient network/rate-limit failures report `retry-safe`.
Successful output JSON contains `prNumber`, `prUrl`, `mergeCommitSha`, `targetBranch`, `baseSha`, and `pushed=true`.
The workflow workspace remains on `workspace.branch` throughout; the action never runs `git checkout <baseBranch>` inside it and never deletes the remote head branch.
Runner typecheck and tests pass: `npm run typecheck -w packages/runner` and `npm test -w packages/runner`.
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/actions/publish-via-pr.ts, updated packages/runner/src/actions/registry.ts, plus runner unit tests covering each step, idempotency path, and every failure kind
tasks.notes: Mock `runCommand` (gh) and `git` in tests; do not hit GitHub. Keep `failureKind` classification logic in pure helper functions so the same classification is testable without spawning processes. The action reads `workspace.branch`, `repository.baseBranch`, `issue.number` from ActionContext like `mohist/publish` does.

tasks.title: Render PR delivery indicator and PR failure kinds in web
tasks.description: Add a `PrDeliveryIndicator` React leaf component to the issue detail page that renders "经由 PR #N 合并" with a hyperlink to the GitHub PR for issues whose publish task result has `output.kind === "publish-via-pr"` and the issue is in a delivered state. The component reads `prNumber`/`prUrl` from the existing WorkflowRun task-result read model; it does NOT call the GitHub HTTP API. Extend `packages/web/src/shared/lib/delivery-failure.ts` so the three new failure kinds (`config-error`, `protection-conflict`, `pr-state-conflict`) render with actionable labels and next-step guidance instead of falling through to the generic failure message.
acceptanceCriteria: For a delivered issue whose publish task `output.kind === "publish-via-pr"`, the issue detail page renders "经由 PR #N 合并" with the PR number and a hyperlink to `prUrl`, visible without drilling into activity dialog or log viewer.
For an issue delivered via `mohist/publish` (direct push), the PR indicator is absent (no placeholder, no empty link).
For an in-progress or undelivered issue, or when PR metadata is missing, the indicator is absent and the detail page renders no error state.

`delivery-failure.ts` maps `config-error` to an environment-config guidance message (install gh + `gh auth login`), `protection-conflict` to a configuration-conflict message, and `pr-state-conflict` to an external-state-change message — each with a clear next action and explicitly marked as non-retryable.
The web client makes no GitHub HTTP API call to resolve PR metadata; all data comes from the existing task-result read model.
Web typecheck and tests pass: `npm run typecheck -w packages/web` and `npm run test:run -w packages/web`, including new component and guidance-mapping tests.
tasks.output: packages/web/src/**/PrDeliveryIndicator.tsx (or extension of the existing delivery-summary widget), updated packages/web/src/shared/lib/delivery-failure.ts, integration on the issue detail page, plus web tests
tasks.notes: Tests can use mock task-result data with `output.kind: "publish-via-pr"`. Mirror the existing conditional-rendering pattern used for delivery-summary elements. The output JSON contract is defined by T-002; consume `output.prNumber` and `output.prUrl` exactly as the runner action emits them.

tasks.title: Render PR delivery failure kinds in CLI guidance
tasks.description: Extend `packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/DeliveryFailureGuidance.cs` so the three new failure kinds (`config-error`, `protection-conflict`, `pr-state-conflict`) emitted by `mohist/publish-via-pr` resolve to actionable labels and next-step guidance, mirroring the existing entries for `conflict` / `base-moved` / `retry-safe`. Operators running `mo` commands must see a distinct, helpful message that distinguishes retryable kinds from human-only kinds.
acceptanceCriteria: `DeliveryFailureGuidance.ResolveFailureKind` recognises `config-error`, `protection-conflict`, and `pr-state-conflict` from runner output JSON `failureKind`.

`DeliveryFailureGuidance.Resolve` returns a label and next-action message for each new kind: `config-error` points to installing `gh` and running `gh auth login`; `protection-conflict` describes a branch-protection configuration conflict; `pr-state-conflict` describes an external PR state change.
The new kinds are marked as non-retryable in the guidance text so operators do not assume workflow retry will converge them.
Existing guidance for `conflict`, `base-moved`, `retry-safe`, `branch-invariant-violation`, and workspace-materialization kinds is unchanged.
Server/CLI tests pass: `npm test` (the CLI renderer specs in `IssueCliTableRendererSpecs.cs` are exercised by the server test project), including new `[InlineData]` rows for the three new kinds.
tasks.output: updated packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/DeliveryFailureGuidance.cs plus new InlineData test rows in packages/server/tests/Mohist.Server.Tests/Specs/Api/IssueCliTableRendererSpecs.cs (or sibling CLI spec file following the existing pattern)
tasks.notes: The CLI guidance is a pure string lookup; no GitHub API calls. Mirror the existing constant-string pattern (e.g. `DeliveryFailureGuidance.BaseMoved`) when adding the new kind constants.
